settings.partReuse.hint: When enabled, interchangeable part positions can be grouped on the 'Part Reuse' page; textures of other parts in the same group become candidates in the package properties and are marked as Multi-Source. Group data is stored in mappings/part_groups.json and is kept after the feature is disabled.
settings.partReuse.notice:
Part Reuse applies where part positions are named differently but their textures are interchangeable: once grouped, textures of the same group can be selected for any part in the package properties.

The equivalence within a group is declared by the user; the program does not verify UV identity, and incorrect grouping results in incorrect textures.

Choosing '{0}': enables the feature and never prompts again; choosing '{1}': keeps it disabled this time and prompts again next time.

pkg.editor.title: Skin Package Properties
pkg.editor.partsHint:
Same from means the same part position. Textures can be picked from other skin packages of the same vehicle to fill missing parts; parts set to 'Not Set' are not output and the game uses its default texture.
Candidates also include textures from other vehicles with the same from, marked as Cross-Vehicle; when Part Reuse is enabled, textures of other parts in the same group are also included, marked with a red Multi-Source tag.
Tags next to part names are inferred from naming conventions and are for reference only.
pkg.editor.partNone: None, this part is not output
pkg.editor.mode.notice:
The write mode of a part is being modified. Please confirm the following:

• replace_tex: Replaces the original texture of this part; used by most parts.
• set_tex: Sets a camo skin texture; also writes param:t="camo_skin_tex" and is generally used only for the main camouflage texture of hull/airframe.

Incorrect usage does not cause game errors, but the skin may not take effect or may behave abnormally.

Choosing '{0}': applies this change and never prompts again; choosing '{1}': makes no changes this time and prompts again next time.
